### Hope in the Southern Kingdom
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/hope-in-southern-kingdom
Passage: 2 Kings 18:1-12
Points:
- Despite succeeding the wicked reign of his father Ahaz, Hezekiah stood as a beacon of hope by doing what was right in God's eyes.
- He boldly purged Judah of idolatry, even shattering Moses' bronze serpent after the people turned it into an idol.
- Scripture highlights his extraordinary devotion and trust in the Lord above all other kings of Judah.
- Because Hezekiah remained steadfastly faithful to God's covenant, the Lord was with him and granted him prosperity.
- No matter how far people fall into spiritual compromise, God is eager to forgive and bless those who repent and return to Him.
